summary: Fixed double-escaping in mailkit/render.py: render() called escape(str(value)), and str() dropped the Markup type, so safe values got escaped again. It now calls escape(value). make dev installed from vendor/ (offline). MarkupSafe 2.1.5 was built from the sdist, but its C speedups extension failed to compile, so it fell back to the pure-Python implementation. make test: 11 passed, including test_markup_values_are_not_double_escaped and test_unescaped_ampersand_in_markup.
